component.name: Badge
component.description: Small, non-interactive text label that tags content with a short category or status (e.g. a course topic). Text only — no icon, not clickable. Two looks: outline (bordered, default) and filled (subtlest neutral fill plus border).

when: Tagging a course or item with its topic (e.g. Design, Design Thinking)
Showing a short, static status or category next to content

patterns.name: topic-list
patterns.description: A wrapping row of outline Badges listing an item's topics.

antiPatterns.scenario: Making a Badge clickable or using it as a filter toggle
antiPatterns.reason: Badge is a display-only <span>; onClick, role and tabIndex are excluded from its props.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use Chip for filter toggles, TextLink or Button for navigation and actions.

antiPatterns.scenario: Adding an icon to a Badge
antiPatterns.alternative: Compose Icon and Text in an Inline if an icon label is needed.

antiPatterns.scenario: Passing long sentences as Badge content
antiPatterns.reason: Badge does not wrap (white-space: nowrap); it is for one- to three-word labels.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use Text for longer descriptive content.

antiPatterns.scenario: Overriding the label's typography or color
antiPatterns.reason: The label renders through Text size=body-small color=subtle; both looks are tuned around it.
antiPatterns.alternative: Pick the variant prop; don't restyle the inner Text.

purpose.outline: Transparent background with the default border. The baseline look.
purpose.filled: Subtlest neutral overlay fill with the default border, for slightly more emphasis or busier surfaces.

states.description: Static label — no interactive, lifecycle or content states.

accessibility.notes: Rendered as a plain <span>; its text is read inline with surrounding content. Not focusable.
